source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "artificial intelligence" AND ("public sector" OR "public administration" OR "public services")
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"artificial intelligence" AND ("public sector" OR "public administration" OR "public services"),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("artificial intelligence" AND ("public administration" OR "public sector" OR "public services"))
